mapper.sql: select a.assign_id,a.activity_id,a.hotel_id,a.order_id,a.room_id,a.guest_name,a.phone,a.room_number, a.check_in_date,a.check_out_date,a.assign_status,a.del_flag,a.create_by,a.create_time,a.update_by,a.update_time,a.remark, h.hotel_name,r.room_name from yc_hotel_assign a left join yc_hotel h on h.hotel_id=a.hotel_id and h.del_flag='0' left join yc_hotel_room r on r.room_id=a.room_id and r.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when assign_status='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as checkedInCount, ifnull(sum(case when assign_status='2' then 1 else 0 end),0) as checkedOutCount from yc_hotel_assign where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_hotel_assign set del_flag='2' where assign_id in #{id}
